name: Baseline Status 3 Code
definition: Indicates the status of a baseline.

PROP.name: Proposed
PROP.definition: Initial state of a baseline in the push-through model.

CLSD.name: Closed
CLSD.definition: Final state of a baseline, in which only reporting is allowed.

PMTC.name: Partially Matched
PMTC.definition: State of the baseline when an initial and at least one twin baselines have been submitted but it has not yet been agreed by all parties.

ESTD.name: Established
ESTD.definition: State of the baseline when it has been agreed by all parties.

ACTV.name: Active
ACTV.definition: State of a baseline, after establishment, when one or more instructions (eg, amendment request, data set submission) have been processed.

COMP.name: Complete
COMP.definition: State of a baseline, after establishment, when all match instructions have been processed, and no such instruction is allowed anymore.

AMRQ.name: Amendment Requested
AMRQ.definition: State of a baseline, after establishment, when an amendment has been requested by one party and has not yet been accepted or rejected by the counterparty(ies).

RARQ.name: Re Activate Requested
RARQ.definition: State of a baseline, after establishment, when an reactivation has been requested by one party and has not yet been accepted or rejected by the counterparty(ies).

CLRQ.name: Close Requested
CLRQ.definition: State of a baseline, after establishment, when a closure has been requested by one party and has not yet been accepted or rejected by the counterparty(ies).

SCRQ.name: Complete Requested
SCRQ.definition: State of a baseline, after establishment, when a completion has been requested by one party and has not yet been accepted or rejected by the counterparty(ies).

SERQ.name: Status Extension Requested
SERQ.definition: State of a baseline when a status extension has been requested by one party and has not yet been accepted or rejected by the counterparty(ies).

DARQ.name: Data Set Acceptance Requested
DARQ.definition: State of a baseline, after establishment, when data set acceptance has been requested by the matching engine and not all responses have been received from the relevant party(ies).
